correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<p<1, 0<epsilon<min(p,1-p) and all positive model coefficients, stationary OU forcing has N(0,s^2) marginal, so even symmetry reduces the invasion exponent gap to sqrt(2/pi)/s ∫_0^infty Q(t)e^{-t²/(2s²)}dt. Expand arctan t at infinity: Q(t)=A/t+O(t^-2), A positive from strict decrease of Holling-II Phi prime. Subtract A*1_{t>=1}/t to obtain integrable R with B=∫R; dominated convergence gives B. Exact 1/2 E1(1/(2s²)) expansion yields log s+(log2-EulerGamma)/2 and the stated o(1/s). Window identity follows algebraically from its two endpoint definitions, without any sample-path or extinction-probability claim. Independently evaluated the rational benchmark A=96/(1225*pi)=0.0249451012846... and scaled leading coefficient 192/(1225*pi*sqrt(2*pi))=0.01990331118265..., matching the formula. No uniformity in degenerate ecological parameters is claimed.
